_doc: #857 THE ORDER OF STORE WORK, declared. When Auto-update is ON and the active network is unmetered (Wi-Fi, or a VPN riding Wi-Fi), pending updates outrank everything else the Store does: the auto chain (StoreAuto) refreshes the queue and downloads every pending update FIRST, while the Store page's work listed in `after` (catalogue refresh = the per-row status check, then row icons and detail fetches it feeds) runs at the same time, never after it. Any other combination (auto-update OFF, or metered) keeps the normal order: the page refreshes immediately. StorePriority reads this file; nothing in Kotlin names the rank or the gate. #861: the page NEVER waits on the chain: the chain runs async on its own max-priority thread (priority in the download queue only) and the check and catalogue render run beside it at once, so a failing or hung chain can never hold the page on Checking.
